title: Multi-Agent Verification: Scaling Test-Time Compute with Multiple Verifiers
authors_zh: Shalev Lifshitz、Sheila A. McIlraith、Yilun Du（机构以官方论文为准）
paper_type_zh: 多验证器测试时扩展论文
best_for_zh: 研究推理预算下验证器集成的读者。
one_line: MAV scales test-time verification by aggregating multiple aspect-specific verifiers over best-of-n candidates.
MAV 通过聚合多个方面验证器来扩展 best-of-n 候选的测试时验证。
why: It separates gains from more verifier judgments from gains from more generated candidates.
inclusion_reason: It explicitly studies verifier count as a test-time scaling axis.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Generating more candidate solutions is only one way to spend test-time compute. A single verifier can miss different kinds of flaw, while repeatedly applying the same judge may amplify one shared blind spot rather than create independent evidence.

The paper asks whether a collection of aspect-specific verifiers can improve the selection of generated answers. It treats the number and diversity of verification agents as a scaling variable, separate from the number of candidate solutions produced by the generator.

生成更多候选解只是花费测试时计算的一种方式。单个验证器可能遗漏不同类型的错误，而反复使用同一个评判器可能放大共同盲点，而不是产生独立证据。

本文研究一组面向不同方面的验证器能否改善对生成答案的选择。它把验证代理的数量和多样性视为独立于生成器候选数量的扩展变量。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Multi-Agent Verification assigns different evaluators to different aspects of an answer and aggregates their judgments when ranking candidates. A candidate need not look uniformly strong to one general-purpose judge; it can be compared through a panel whose members focus on complementary properties.

The proposed best-of-N multi-agent verification procedure combines candidate sampling with this verifier panel. Its premise is that a larger verification budget is useful when it adds meaningful diversity, not merely more copies of an equally biased scoring function.

多代理验证让不同评估器负责答案的不同方面，并在候选排序时聚合它们的判断。候选不必在一个通用评判器眼中显得全面强大；它可以通过成员关注互补属性的评审组被比较。

所提出的最佳候选多代理验证过程把候选采样与该验证面板结合。其前提是，只有当更大的验证预算带来有意义的多样性，而不只是更多同样有偏评分函数的副本时，它才有用。

title: Method
方法
html:
The method samples several answers for an input, obtains scores from a set of aspect verifiers, and aggregates those scores to choose an answer. The paper also studies weak-to-strong and self-improvement settings, so the verifier configuration is part of the inference design rather than a fixed external oracle.

A proper experimental record therefore includes the candidate count, the identities or prompts of each verifier, the aspect assigned to each one, the aggregation rule, and the total verifier calls. Those details distinguish an improvement from better generation from an improvement caused by spending more computation on judgment.

该方法为输入采样多个答案，从一组方面验证器获得分数，并聚合这些分数选择答案。论文还研究弱到强和自我改进设定，因此验证器配置是推理设计的一部分，而不是固定的外部预言机。

因此，正确的实验记录应包含候选数量、每个验证器的身份或提示、分配给它的方面、聚合规则和验证器调用总数。这些细节区分了来自更好生成的改进和来自在判断上投入更多计算的改进。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports that multi-agent verification scales more favorably than the compared single-verifier, self-consistency, and reward-model baselines in its experiments. It further presents gains in settings where verifier strength or the training configuration changes, supporting the claim that a panel can create useful selection information.

That evidence is conditional on the chosen tasks, base models, verifier prompts, and aggregation protocol. It does not show that simply adding agents always helps: correlated judges can agree on the same mistake, and a panel with much larger total inference cost must be compared under a matched budget.

论文报告，在其实验中，多代理验证比所比较的单验证器、自一致性和奖励模型基线扩展得更有利。它还展示了验证器强度或训练配置变化时的收益，支持验证面板能够创造有用选择信息的主张。

这些证据依赖所选择的任务、基础模型、验证器提示和聚合协议。它并不表明只要增加代理就一定有帮助：相关的评判器可能同意同一个错误，而总推理成本大得多的面板必须在匹配预算下比较。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The new decision is to scale verification along an aspect dimension, rather than only scaling samples or selecting with one scalar reward. This makes verification composition—who checks what and how their opinions are combined—an explicit object of test-time optimization.

Earlier best-of-N pipelines often hide the verifier behind a single score. Here the verifier panel is part of the algorithm and can be varied independently of generation. The contribution is not multi-agent conversation for its own sake, but a structured way to test whether diverse judgments improve candidate selection.

新的决策是在方面维度上扩展验证，而不只是扩展样本或用一个标量奖励选择。这使验证组成——谁检查什么、他们的意见如何合并——成为测试时优化的明确对象。

早期最佳候选流程常把验证器隐藏在一个单一分数之后。这里，验证面板是算法的一部分，可以独立于生成而变化。贡献并不是为了多代理对话本身，而是一种检验多样判断是否改善候选选择的结构化方法。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The method can be expensive because every candidate may be inspected by several judges, and the value of extra agents depends on errors being sufficiently uncorrelated. Aspect definitions and judge prompts are design choices that can leak task knowledge or favor a preferred answer style. Aggregation can also hide disagreement that would be useful for abstention. Reproduction should report the full verifier panel, model versions, prompts, call counts, latency, and the extent to which verifier tasks overlap with the final evaluation, rather than treating “multiple agents” as a complete specification.
该方法可能成本很高，因为每个候选都可能由多个评判器检查，额外代理的价值取决于错误是否足够不相关。方面定义和评判提示都是设计选择，可能泄露任务知识或偏向某种答案风格。聚合还可能隐藏本可用于弃答的分歧。复现时应报告完整验证面板、模型版本、提示、调用次数、时延，以及验证器任务与最终评估重叠的程度，而不能把“多个代理”当成完整说明。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work to design an ablation in which generation and verification budgets are independently controlled. Hold the candidate pool fixed, add one aspect verifier at a time, inspect score correlation and marginal accuracy, and compare against a single verifier receiving the same total token or call budget. It is useful for tasks with identifiable complementary checks, such as factual support, calculation, or instruction compliance. It is less suitable when no credible aspect decomposition exists or when verification latency dominates the product requirement.
可以使用本文设计一项让生成预算和验证预算独立受控的消融实验。固定候选池，每次增加一个方面验证器，检查分数相关性和边际准确率，并与获得相同总 token 或调用预算的单验证器比较。它适用于具有可识别互补检查的任务，例如事实支持、计算或指令遵循。当不存在可信的方面分解，或验证时延主导产品需求时，它就不太适合。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the result as an argument for measuring verifier diversity, not just verifier count. The central table should separate candidate-generation calls from each verifier call and report how agreement, disagreement, and error correlation change as agents are added. A headline best-of-N score is insufficient if the panel has more information or more compute than the baseline. The most informative failure case is a confidently wrong consensus: it reveals whether the panel adds independent scrutiny or merely repeats one latent preference.
应把结果读作衡量验证器多样性的论证，而不仅是验证器数量的论证。核心表格应把候选生成调用与每次验证器调用分开，并报告随着代理增加，一致、分歧和错误相关性如何变化。如果面板比基线拥有更多信息或更多计算，一个醒目的最佳候选分数并不充分。最有信息量的失败案例是自信但错误的一致结论：它揭示面板是否增加了独立审查，还是只重复某个潜在偏好。
